author: Episteme III
title: Experiment 1: Radius Perturbation Strategy
abstract:
This experiment proposes a new method to escape the SOTA's local optimum. Instead of perturbing circle positions, this strategy directly perturbs the radii distribution.
It loads the SOTA packing, identifies the circles with the maximum and minimum radii, and applies a small, inverse perturbation (shrinking the largest, growing the smallest).
This altered configuration is then re-optimized using SLSQP, aiming to explore a new path in the solution space.
